metricDefinitions.abstentionAccuracy: aligned NO_EXPLICIT_IMPLEMENTATION concepts explicitly ABSTAINED with reason and no candidates divided by abstention cases
metricDefinitions.conceptExtractionCoverage: aligned CONFIRMED production concepts divided by CONFIRMED gold concepts
metricDefinitions.evidenceCompleteness: candidates with paper location/text and commit/path/symbol/startLine divided by evaluated candidates
metricDefinitions.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant symbol over CONFIRMED concepts
metricDefinitions.needsReviewRatio: NEEDS_REVIEW candidates divided by evaluated candidates
metricDefinitions.precisionAtK: macro mean of relevant symbols in top K divided by K over CONFIRMED concepts
metricDefinitions.recallAtK: macro mean of relevant symbols in top K divided by all gold symbols over CONFIRMED concepts
